scope: Official YouTube Analytics API, requiring permission to view a channel or content owner's aggregated reports; no account connection is requested or used.

field_semantics.label: Net total estimated channel revenue
field_semantics.definition: creator estimated net revenue from Google-sold advertising and non-ad monetization sources in accessible reports
field_semantics.limitations: not an ad-only variable; subscriptions and fan payments may overlap other financial inputs

field_semantics.label: Net advertising
field_semantics.definition: estimated creator-side advertising proceeds from Google-sold advertising
field_semantics.limitations: not grossRevenue; does not cover partner-sold ads

field_semantics.label: Gross advertising
field_semantics.definition: gross proceeds before owner share and revenue-sharing agreements
field_semantics.limitations: not a creator payout or profit

field_semantics.label: Verified advertisements delivered
field_semantics.limitations: can exceed monetized playbacks due to multiple ads

field_semantics.label: Playbacks with at least one ad shown
field_semantics.definition: monetized playback count; may count even if viewer leaves the preroll before video starts
field_semantics.limitations: not total eligible views and not unique people

field_semantics.label: Advertiser-side CPM
field_semantics.definition: gross advertising revenue per thousand ad impressions
field_semantics.limitations: not creator RPM; not equivalent to playbackBasedCpm

field_semantics.label: Playback-based CPM
field_semantics.definition: gross advertising revenue per thousand monetized playbacks

field_semantics.label: Video view events
field_semantics.definition: platform-defined views in a requested date range and video scope
field_semantics.limitations: platform definition changes; not unique people; long/Shorts definitions can differ

field_semantics.label: Engaged views
field_semantics.definition: viewing that meets YouTube's current engaged-view criteria
field_semantics.limitations: not interchangeable with public viewCount or unique viewers

field_semantics.label: Average playback duration
field_semantics.definition: estimated average playback duration for report scope

field_semantics.label: Logged-in viewing percentage
field_semantics.definition: share of viewing involving logged-in viewers according to report definition

field_semantics.label: Thumbnail impressions
field_semantics.definition: eligible on-YouTube impressions of video thumbnails
field_semantics.limitations: not total video views or paid ad impressions

field_semantics.label: Thumbnail impression click-through rate
field_semantics.definition: click-through ratio of qualifying thumbnail impressions
field_semantics.limitations: not buying conversion or ad click-through rate

field_semantics.label: Subscriber gains
field_semantics.definition: subscribes attributed to channel in report period

field_semantics.label: Subscriber losses
field_semantics.definition: unsubscribes attributed to channel in report period
field_semantics.limitations: not all viewers who stopped watching

field_semantics.label: Shares
field_semantics.definition: video shares counted under available report

supported_dimensions.meaning: Monthly time aggregation, not unique monthly active viewers
Country associated with the reported measured activity
Age bracket of logged-in audience in permitted reports
Gender of logged-in audience in permitted reports
Video-level grouping for reports allowing this dimension

template_queries.purpose: Track actual channel earning across days; separate gross from net and non-ad streams.
Compare reporting rows by viewer country, not country of creator residence.
Examine top video revenue observations in a single channel or content owner rights scope.
Inspect permitted aggregate demographic groups, accepting suppression and limits; not public-platform composition.

invalid_arithmetic.reason: Owner shares, adjustments, taxes and costs are not subtracted.
estimatedRevenue also includes eligible non-ad revenue and can double-count later added funding.
CPM counts advertising impressions before YouTube's share, while RPM is creator-side and uses video view denominators.
One playback can have multiple ads; impressions and playbacks are distinct events.
A person can watch repeatedly, including autoplay starts after metric changes.

invalid_arithmetic.statement: Country report gives country of publisher
invalid_arithmetic.reason: country is a viewer/activity geographic dimension, not creator residence.

invalid_arithmetic.statement: Change of currency parameter changes payout threshold
invalid_arithmetic.reason: Analytic currency conversion and AdSense payment-account reporting currency are separate.

collection_constraints: Require explicit permission of actual channel/account owner; never access private analytics by scraping or impersonation.
Document query dates, authorization scope, API metric definitions, sample selection and privacy suppression.
If fields are unavailable to the given authorization scope, record unknown rather than zero.
Never archive personal viewer histories or identities.
Do not treat an isolated creator sample as representative of platform-wide creator earnings.
